import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModules
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.DegreeVanishing

/-!
# Point evaluation of divisor-module sections

Surjectivity in degree-zero cohomology of the divisor devissage sequence
produces a global section of the structure-sheaf module `O(D)` attaining the
divisor bound at the chosen closed point. The jump quotient is the residue
field, so a nonzero jump detects a generator in the local divisor lattice.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (D : X.CurveDivisor)

/-- Degree-zero surjectivity in devissage lifts every jump value to a global section. -/
theorem jumpProj_surjective_of_hModule_zero_surjective
    (h : Function.Surjective (Sheaf.HModule.map (devissageSES K hx D).g 0)) :
    Function.Surjective (jumpProj K hx D ⊤ (Opens.mem_top x)) := by
  let e₂ := Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ _ isTerminalTop (divisorSheaf K D)
  let e₃ := Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ _ isTerminalTop
    (skyModule x (jumpModule K hx D))
  let e := (eqToIso (skyModule_obj_of_mem x (jumpModule K hx D)
    (Opens.mem_top x))).toLinearEquiv
  intro t
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h (e₃.symm (e.symm t))
  refine ⟨e₂ z, ?_⟩
  have hs : ((devissageπ K hx D).hom.app (op ⊤)).hom (e₂ z) = e.symm t := by
    rw [Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀_naturality]
    change e₃ (Sheaf.HModule.map (devissageSES K hx D).g 0 z) = e.symm t
    rw [hz, e₃.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [devissageπ_app_hom_apply_of_mem K hx D (op ⊤) (Opens.mem_top x)] at hs
  exact e.symm.injective hs

/-- A nonzero jump means that the section attains the divisor bound at the point. -/
theorem divisorVal_ord_eq_of_jumpProj_ne_zero {U : X.Opens} (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (s : divisorSections K D U) (hs : jumpProj K hx D U hxU s ≠ 0) :
    Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (divisorVal K s) =
      divisorBound D hx := by
  have hupper := (mem_pointLattice K hx).mp
    (divisorSections_le_pointLattice K hx D U hxU s.2)
  have hlower : ¬ Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
      (s : X.functionField) ≤
        ((Multiplicative.ofAdd (coeffAt hx D - 1) : Multiplicative ℤ) :
          WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := by
    intro h
    exact hs ((jumpProj_eq_zero_iff K hx D hxU s).mpr
      ((mem_pointLattice K hx).mpr h))
  rw [divisorVal_coe, divisorBound_eq_coeffAt]
  generalize Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (s : X.functionField) = v
    at hupper hlower ⊢
  induction v using WithZero.recZeroCoe with
  | zero => exact (hlower zero_le).elim
  | coe v =>
    rw [WithZero.coe_le_coe] at hupper hlower
    apply congrArg (fun a : Multiplicative ℤ => (a : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    change v.toAdd ≤ coeffAt hx D at hupper
    change ¬ v.toAdd ≤ coeffAt hx D - 1 at hlower
    change v.toAdd = coeffAt hx D
    omega

/-- A surjective cohomological evaluation produces a global divisor-module section
whose local value generates the divisor lattice at the chosen closed point. -/
theorem exists_divisorModules_section_ord_eq_of_hModule_zero_surjective
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (h : Function.Surjective (Sheaf.HModule.map (devissageSES K hx D).g 0)) :
    ∃ s : Γ(divisorModules K D, ⊤),
      Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (divisorVal K s) =
        divisorBound D hx := by
  let e := jumpEquivResidueField K hx D
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := jumpProj_surjective_of_hModule_zero_surjective K hx D h (e.symm 1)
  refine ⟨s, divisorVal_ord_eq_of_jumpProj_ne_zero K hx D (Opens.mem_top x) s ?_⟩
  rw [hs]
  intro hzero
  apply one_ne_zero (show (1 : X.residueField x) = 0 from ?_)
  simpa using congrArg e hzero

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
